A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Hybrid Test-Time Scaling work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–F are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original experiments across five LLMs on MATH500, AIME24, and GPQA Diamond, including component ablations and supplementary analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments, with revised numerical results in several tables and Figure 3.

M1.justification: The generation control, PRM-guided conditional self-refinement, Best-of-N selection, and tree-search procedure are unchanged. Algorithm 1 only renames comments from Feedback/Rewrite to Reflection/Revision.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same mathematical and scientific reasoning coverage using MATH500, AIME24, and GPQA Diamond. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: Figure 2 retains its scaling baselines, Table 3 retains both PRMs, and Table 4 retains BoN+Self-Refinement, MCTS+BoN, and OpenR. Revised comparator scores do not introduce new methods.

E3.justification: The five evaluated LLMs, sampling/search configurations, Maj@k/RM@k/Pass@k metrics, and refinement thresholds remain unchanged. No revised experimental protocol or additional experiment is documented.

E4.justification: Existing analytical evidence is revised: Figure 3 changes the LLaMA3.1-8B step-refinement curve, and Table 4's component ablation changes MCTS+BoN from tying Hybrid TTS to trailing it on GPQA Pass@16. The analytical questions, sensitivity studies, and appendix case study are retained.

E5.justification: Section 4 retains the single-run statement, while Appendix E and Figure 7 retain the same four repeated trials. No new seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty-reporting practices appear.

E6.justification: Several reported values change under unchanged stated settings. Examples include Qwen2.5-14B GPQA Pass@16, 55.6 to 59.1 in Table 2; MCTS+BoN GPQA Pass@16, 51.5 to 49.0 in Tables 4–5; and BoN+Self-Refinement's Best-of-8 accuracy, 35.4 to 37.9 in Table 5. Figure 3 and Section 5.2's numerical examples also change. The PDFs do not establish whether these updates reflect corrections or reruns.

T1.justification: The PUCT expression in Equation 1 and FLOPs expression in Equation 2 are mathematically unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: conditional step-level self-refinement, hybrid parallel/sequential scaling, and the importance of accurate verification. The conclusion's wording changes without changing these claims.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning latent reasoning potential, verification quality, exploration versus exploitation, and temperature-related instability remain unchanged. Section 5.2 updates illustrative observations, while the inference-cost caveat and appendix limitations are retained.

D1.justification: The OpenR/vLLM implementation, two 80G A800 GPUs, generation settings, hyperparameters, Appendix A prompts, and code-access disclosures are retained. Appendix C's fuller model names repeat information already available elsewhere.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain the same. Added publication years, expanded venue metadata, and changed Zhang citation suffixes are bibliographic corrections rather than new related work.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited copyediting throughout, standardizes terminology and acronym introductions, corrects typos, supplies missing citation years, and lightly rewrites the conclusion. The section and appendix organization is unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 2, 4, and 5 have revised axis ticks and formatting. Table 5 replaces Tokens/Score headings with # Tokens/Acc.; typography, equation layout, and the appendix case-study layout also change. The same figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 improves reporting consistency: Table 5's revised 37.9 agrees with Table 4, and Section 5.2's Gemma verification gap of 20.7 points matches Table 2's 53.5 minus 32.8, unlike the earlier 10.4-point Qwen example. Copyediting and clearer headings also help. These limited gains are partly offset by a new discrepancy: the same Hybrid TTS result is 35.4 in Table 2 but 35.3 in Table 4.
